{{Top}}
A '''telescope''' was a device used to magnify images in much the same way as a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]]. It was presumably related to the [[Electrotelescope/Legends|electrotelescope]].

==Characteristics==
A telescope was a type of simple [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. It examined the energy emitted by other sources.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
In [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] longed for an optical telescope as opposed to the electronic magnifier aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]] that was not functioning due to the effects of the [[Flamewind of Oseon/Legends|Flamewind]].<ref name="LCatFoO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>

During his time on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] wished he owned a telescope rather than his macrobinoculars.<ref name="Ep4Novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

While talking with [[Teneniel Djo]], Prince [[Isolder]] remarked that if one had a powerful enough telescope, they could see the [[Fere]] inhabitants as they once were many years ago before they were wiped out by a plague, by seeing the light reflected off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] just reaching the eye. However, Isolder then said, that such a telescope did not exist.<ref name="TCoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

Prior to its destruction at the beginning of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the outpost of [[ExGal-4]] on [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]] used both ground-based and orbiting scopes.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>
